scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.seed
scripts.test:api: cd apps/api && uv run --extra dev pytest
scripts.test:analysis: cd apps/api && uv run --extra dev pytest ../../packages/analysis/tests
scripts.test: npm run test:analysis && npm run test:api
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && cd apps/api && uv run --extra dev ruff check app migrations tests ../../packages/analysis
scripts.migrate: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.migrate upgrade head
scripts.validate:packs: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.validate_packs
